messages.content: Write a customer testimonial section for the website of a log aggregation service. Around 200 words.

output:
## What our customers say

> "We had forty services logging to forty different places. During an incident, the first twenty minutes always went to figuring out which box to SSH into. Now I type one query and get every service's view of the same request ID. Our last Sev-1 postmortem put time-to-diagnosis at nine minutes."
>
> **Priya Raghunathan** — Staff SRE, Northwind Freight

> "I moved us over during a hiring freeze, so cost was the entire argument. We keep 30 days hot and archive the rest, and the bill came in under what we were paying for 7 days with our old vendor. Nobody has asked me to justify the line item since."
>
> **Tomas Beck** — Director of Infrastructure, Cadence Health

> "Our previous query language needed a training session and a cheat sheet taped to the monitor. I sat a junior engineer down on a Tuesday, and by Thursday she was building her own dashboards without me. That's the whole review."
>
> **Dana Whitfield** — Engineering Manager, Loomis Analytics

> "Black Friday, we pushed six times our normal log volume through it. Ingestion didn't drop a line, and my phone stayed quiet."
>
> **Marcus Oyelaran** — Platform Lead, Vessel Commerce

*(~200 words. Names and companies are placeholders — swap in real quotes with written permission before publishing.)*
